purpose: 以封面的志怪版画风格重绘探索人物和斗法画面。

world_atlas.left: 以向右侧视图镜像绘制
world_atlas.one_column: 地图 NPC 和无相之身使用每个方向的静立帧；无相之身移动时轻微浮动。
world_atlas.anchor: 每格水平居中，鞋底距格底 3 像素。

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A production-ready transparent game character sheet for the Chinese Liaozhai RPG Painted Skin. Image 1 is STYLE only: mottled rice paper pigment inside each silhouette, hand-carved black ink contours, dry engraving hatching, near-black, grey jade, indigo, faded cinnabar and warm ivory. Every character must read like a historical woodcut figure from the same book as Image 1. Use real anatomy with long limbs, small heads (roughly 7–7.5 heads tall for adults), readable silhouettes and a subdued woodblock palette. Strong clean silhouette, controlled ink shading and contrast readable when reduced to 60px. Use an elevated orthographic RPG angle, only mildly above eye level; no lens perspective. No pixel art, chibi, anime, poster, text, labels, grid lines, scenery, panels, cast shadows, items floating off figures, or baselines. RGBA TRANSPARENT background everywhere between characters. No overlap, each complete figure has generous empty space around it including above hats and below both shoes. EXACTLY NINE full-body isolated sprites in a strict evenly spaced 3x3 matrix, one figure at the center of every cell, with column centers 16.7%, 50%, 83.3% and row centers 16.7%, 50%, 83.3%. ROW 1: facing directly toward viewer, front. ROW 2: facing away from viewer, back. ROW 3: right-facing full profile. Within EVERY row column 1 is feet together idle, column 2 is mid-walk stride left foot forward right foot back, column 3 is the alternate mid-walk right foot forward left foot back. Show both shoes, and use believable arm counter-swing. Same figure height and same stable base of the feet within each cell. Lu Zhiwei, a lean twenty-seven year old Qing book copyist. Exactly the indigo ankle-length robe, warm weathered umber sleeveless vest, soft folded charcoal cloth cap, braid, light canvas cross-body satchel and black cloth boots from reference 2. At profile he looks to screen RIGHT. Hands free for natural walking.

Use case: style-transfer. A wide 16:9 illustrated game battle plate. Image 1 is the composition reference of the existing Qing inn courtyard, with roofed side room on left, old well far right, center gate and low wall behind, unobstructed court in the bottom half. Image 2 is the only artistic style reference from the title screen. Repaint this exact place as a somber Liaozhai woodblock print at the end of a rainstorm. Hard black ink contours, distinct dry-brush worn paper grain, old chalky plaster walls, slate-blue and green-gray ink washes in shadow, old iron-grey tile, one desaturated red lantern and a cool small ivory moon through ink clouds. Flat layers of hand-carved ink texture rather than pixels or photographic shading. Uncanny stillness, enough candlelight and moon haze to read the room and keep dark actors visible. Lower 55% of the frame is quiet fairly even mid-value worn wet flagstone, with subtle shallow puddles. Combat figures are composited by the game; no people, ghosts, statues, round platforms, text, decals, interface, frame or watermark. The scene is a modest provincial inn, no grand palaces.
